verdict.rationale: Galileo's release notes mention a built-in AI Assistant for troubleshooting agentic systems, so the product does ship an in-product assistant. The evidence is one release-note line, with no detail on what tasks can be delegated or how. The MCP server serves external IDE assistants rather than being a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's scope and which tasks it can perform, evidence it can take actions beyond troubleshooting, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Troubleshoot your agentic system with the AI Assistant.
